descriptions: The {LOCATION} is {ADJ} with tension. The {ANTAGONIST} has caught your trail.
The {CHARACTER} from before appears at your side. 'Through here. The {MACGUFFIN} will open the door.'

commands.look: The {ANTAGONIST} is visible at the far end. The ally holds the line. North is your escape.
commands.talk to {CHARACTER}: 'I'll hold them. Go north. Don't stop.'

latents.fact: a glass vial has rolled under the {ADJ} furniture — still sealed, contents unclear
latents.item_desc: A small glass vial, sealed with wax. The liquid inside shifts colour when tilted.

latents.fact: the window in this room doesn't show the outside — it shows a different room entirely
one of the {ADJ} marks on the wall is actually a door seam — it opens inward with enough pressure
latents.exit_desc: A concealed door in the wall, leading to a dim passage.
